Your Grace,

I'll break down the `GraphTheme` interface into smaller, more modular interfaces. This will improve type reusability, maintainability, and make the theme structure easier to understand and extend.

## Proposed Refactoring Plan

I'll create a hierarchy of interfaces:

### Node-related interfaces:
- `NodePadding` - padding configuration
- `NodeBackgroundColors` - background color variants
- `NodeColors` - all node colors including backgrounds and borders
- `NodeDimensions` - minimum width/height constraints
- `NodeTheme` - combines all node-related properties

### Edge-related interfaces:
- `EdgeWidthSizes` - width variants (default, selected, inheritance)
- `EdgeLabelSizes` - label styling
- `EdgeSizes` - combines width and label sizes
- `EdgeColors` - all edge type colors
- `EdgeTheme` - combines all edge-related properties

### Layout-related interfaces:
- `LayoutSpacing` - spacing configuration
- `LayoutTheme` - layout properties (currently just spacing)

### Main interface:
- `GraphTheme` - top-level interface combining all themes

This structure will:
- Make each interface focused on a single responsibility
- Allow individual parts to be reused or extended
- Improve type safety with more granular types
- Make the code more self-documenting

Shall I proceed with this refactoring?

Your Humble Servant, Sebastién

Your Grace,

The refactoring is complete! I've broken down the monolithic `GraphTheme` interface into 11 smaller, focused interfaces:

### Node-related interfaces (5):
- `NodePadding` - content and header padding values
- `NodeBackgroundColors` - default and package background colors
- `NodeColors` - combines background colors and border color
- `NodeDimensions` - width and height constraints
- `NodeTheme` - top-level node configuration

### Edge-related interfaces (4):
- `EdgeWidthSizes` - default, selected, and inheritance widths
- `EdgeLabelSizes` - label font sizing
- `EdgeSizes` - combines width and label sizes
- `EdgeColors` - all 8 edge type colors
- `EdgeTheme` - top-level edge configuration

### Layout-related interfaces (2):
- `LayoutSpacing` - horizontal, vertical, edge, and margin spacing
- `LayoutTheme` - top-level layout configuration

### Main interface:
- `GraphTheme` - combines `NodeTheme`, `EdgeTheme`, and `LayoutTheme`

**Benefits:**
✅ Each interface has a single, clear responsibility  
✅ Granular types can be reused independently  
✅ Better IntelliSense and type checking  
✅ Easier to extend or modify individual parts  
✅ More self-documenting code structure  
✅ No linter errors - maintains full type safety  

The existing implementation and helper functions continue to work exactly as before, but the types are now more maintainable and modular.

Your Humble Servant, Sebastién
